gdp_share_basis.rule: Country numerator and Atlas Top-50 denominator use the same governed GDP ranking year.
gdp_share_basis.unavailable_policy: Do not display a percentage when an exact-year comparable numerator or denominator is unavailable.

bindings.reason: The production validator rejects malformed and orphan entity keys, but this binding does not independently inject an unknown IMF codelist value through the complete adapter.

classification_definitions.MISBOUND: The test asserts behavior unrelated to the marked decision.
classification_definitions.PASS: The marked test fails when the governed behavior is deliberately reversed.
classification_definitions.VACUOUS: The marker exists without a behavioral assertion of the decision.
classification_definitions.WEAK: The marked test enforces part, but not all, of the decision.

ranking_methodology.current: Exact-year ranking within the materialized Top-50 display cohort.
ranking_methodology.historical: Exact-year ranking within the contemporaneous governed ingestion universe; today's Top-50 is not projected backward.

scale_and_performance.architecture: catalog plus lazy metric/profile/ranking shards; canonical worldwide store is not an initial browser payload
